limits: Actual proof is original caller-returned controlled observer facts plus original local transport streams; it is not independent remote receipt/marker/header/CPP/object/product/Cstdout retrieval or filesystem durability proof.
Runtime C stdout hashes/size and parsed facts are preserved as metadata/derived objects; no original raw C body is reconstructed or asserted independently saved.
Source/prelaunch/CI reviews were not rerun; only current deployed copy hashes and prior exact receipt bindings were checked.
147 dependencies include translation unit;13 LOAD aliases are snapshots after link, not full toolchain/mapped-code authentication.
Own direct worker normal/loss success is not arbitrary descendant/production containment, resource lease, model-runtime ABI, Tensor/gradient/training/GPU or foreign queue restoration.
Synthetic/positive cases do not dynamically validate C failure clock/cleanup branches, async/guard/coordinator/observer/host-loss recovery or receipt completeness.
Actual PID, nonce, root, request, product and argv records are permanently consumed; no probe/retrieve/replay/resume/fallback is authorized by this audit.
Transport duration is not model latency/performance or capability improvement; no natural external trials occurred.
